d:
Bihar ke mokama vidhayak anant sinh in dinon apni beti shivangi ki shadi ko lekar charcha men hain. shivangi ki haldi seremni ka vidiyo soshal midiya par samne aaya hai, jismen anant sinh apne alag hi andaj men najar aa rahe hain. kabhi munchhon par tav dete dikhe to kabhi shadi ke jashn men jamkar jhumte najar aae.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
